Regarding the technical content provided: Photovoltaic (PV) cells, commonly known as solar panels, generate electricity by capturing sunlight. Inside these cells, materials like silicon absorb light particles (photons), which energizes electrons and causes them to move. This flow of electrons creates an electrical current that can be used as power. This process offers a clean energy alternative that helps reduce dependence on fossil fuels and lowers greenhouse gas emissions.
